metadata.version: live V4 (v4:* cards observed; deployment identifier not independently retrieved in this run)
metadata.method: Read-only live get_Word/get_Passage, evidence view, top 25, prior query/mode mapping. Match Strong IDs or verse refs in card title/endpoints/refs/target with normalized zeros and same-chapter range containment. Fallback to non-source witness refs for previously assessable cases with no explicit Strong/ref targets. Weak aliases diagnostic only. Results manually transcribed from live batch summaries; full raw responses not saved. Target matches not semantic passes. 29 qualitative cases reviewed via selected returned cards, not full provenance audits. Negative controls screened, not certified. Baseline matcher differed. Supplemental X240 is post-hoc and not a frozen or blinded case. No writes to repository or research graph.
